dependency list lacks temporal activation, integration response, and higher-order relation protection
controls do not provide general multilayer relation graph
Atlas is navigational map, not adaptive reconfiguration substrate
causal specialization delegates non-causal relations elsewhere

value priority relation is not machine-readable as adaptive network

distinctions.matrix_vs_network_vs_map: Matrices and registries store structured rows; networks model typed relations; maps are projections and navigation aids.
distinctions.relation_vs_causality: Relations include similarity, support, conflict, identity, value, resource and dependency; causality delegates to MCF.
distinctions.static_vs_temporal: Static adjacency cannot create time-respecting paths.
distinctions.pairwise_vs_higher_order: Group interactions require HyperRelation and cannot be silently reduced to pairs.
distinctions.stored_vs_retrievable_vs_integrated: External availability and retrieval are not judgment/action/transfer integration.
distinctions.diffusion_vs_learning: Exposure and diffusion are not proof of durable learning or behavior adoption.
